build_system: npm with Next.js CLI. Bun 1.2.14 also available. Node 22.23.1 installed via mise.
test_framework: No test framework configured - no test files exist in the project
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-league-tracker && npm install && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install to install dependencies. 2. Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compiles and Next.js builds successfully. 3. Run npm run lint to check for linting errors.
setup_instructions: 1. Run `mise use node@22` in workspace root. 2. cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-league-tracker && npm install
environment_constraints: Node.js not pre-installed but available via mise (node@22). npm registry is reachable. No Docker available. No test framework configured.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md says: This is Next.js 16 with potential breaking changes from training data. Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code. However, that docs dir does not exist, so rely on existing code patterns.
key_patterns: Client components use 'use client' directive. Components in app/components/. API routes in app/api/. Lib helpers in lib/. Tailwind CSS 4 with dark theme (gray-950 bg). Semantic HTML with aria-labels on sections. URLSearchParams used for API query params.
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js App Router pages and components. app/components/ - React client components. app/api/riot/ - API route for Riot Games proxy. lib/ - shared utilities and types. public/ - static assets.
